evidence: In the heart of Van Phuc Ward, Ha Dong District, a fascinating sight awaits visitors in the bustling silk workshops. Amidst the vibrant atmosphere, modern flat knitting machines stand tall, their silver-gray hue and multi-colored yarn strands a striking visual treat.

The flat knitting machines, with their sturdy, rectangular bodies, resemble giant tables, proudly standing in the middle of the brightly lit textile workshop. The slider assembly, featuring thousands of tiny needles, glides swiftly horizontally and vertically, weaving the name "Van Phuc" into the fabric of the silk.

The flat knitting machines are a symbol of the region's cultural significance, a testament to the enduring power of tradition and innovation. They represent the ability of cultural heritage to transform and evolve, while remaining true to its roots.
